import boto3, datetime
rds = boto3.client('rds')
cutoff = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(tzinfo=None) - datetime.timedelta(days={{retain_days}})
snaps = rds.describe_db_snapshots(DBInstanceIdentifier='{{db_instance_id}}', SnapshotType='manual')['DBSnapshots']
for s in snaps:
    if s['SnapshotCreateTime'].replace(tzinfo=None) < cutoff:
        print('deleting', s['DBSnapshotIdentifier'])
        rds.delete_db_snapshot(DBSnapshotIdentifier=s['DBSnapshotIdentifier'])
summary_zh: 清理 N 天前的手動 RDS snapshot
